name: ladder
description: Orchestrator plugin: /orchestrate conducts a multi-step build (Opus plans, Sonnet builds, Haiku does bulk work), an always-on delegation policy sets the tier on every Agent call, a self-updater keeps it current, and the conductor gate (/conduct, /direct, money guards, optional root lock) keeps the main window conducting. It never switches the session model.

updates.title: Updates
updates.description: Every few weeks compare the installed version with the published one. notify: say so and leave it to /ladder update. apply: pull it in (a git checkout fast-forwards; a marketplace copy runs claude plugin update), then /reload-plugins.

updateEveryDays.title: Days between update checks
updateEveryDays.description: How often to look. /ladder update looks now.
